title: Pairing with the small bias generator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\ell>0$, and choose an irreducible monic binary polynomial of degree $\ell$ to define the certified binary field implementation. For binary vectors $\gamma$ of length $n$ and $r,s$ of length $\ell$, the dot product of $\gamma$ with the generated length-$n$ vector whose $i$th coordinate is the pairing of $s$ with $r^{i+1}$ equals the dot product of $s$ with the sum $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i r^{i+1}$, where the powers and sum use that field implementation.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation with irreducible modulus
